statement: The bytes a frame signature covers name the Account fully (chain id, Depository address, both entity ids in canonical order, the epoch) and the proof nonce: a frame signed for one Account is refused when replayed into another Account of the same signer, into another epoch, or at another nonce, because the verifier recovers another signer (shown on the digests in account/proof; on the wire the Entity checks the peer's signature over the head it computed itself, in the Account's own context, so a signature over another Account's, epoch's or nonce's head is refused: R-SIGNED-HEADS-ON-THE-WIRE). The Entity builds one context per Account from the chain facts it holds for it (its key, the epoch, the first nonce = stored + 2), so two Accounts of one Entity sign different bytes for the same txs, and two epochs of one Account do too. The deployment and the proof terms are one anchor for the whole Runtime (Setup.anchor); per-Account windows are not in the signed terms yet (set_windows is the node's alone, the peer would seal different bytes).
source: coordinator 10-01 06:25 (Review A of PR 93: a frame's hash did not name its Account)
